output.title: OperatorHub packages discontinued; environment installs via Helm/Flux/Argo
output.content: The change only affects installing cert-manager from OperatorHub packages (RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub or operatorhub.io), which stop at v1.16.5. The environment summary shows cert-manager installed through other channels: a flux-helmrelease (chart cert-manager), an argocd-application, a helm-annotation and a helmfile (jetstack/cert-manager). No OperatorHub or OLM source appears in the installed products, though the CRDs dimension is absent. If any cert-manager instance is actually managed via OLM/OperatorHub, the operator should confirm that, since no new packages exist for v1.18.0.
